name: crew-fleet-panels-visual
description: Redesign P6: Operations panel's unclaimed-work line, and (once wired in P6-cleanup) the Crew and Fleet panels themselves.

steps.description: Setup: hire a driller and a driver so the crew roster is non-empty, buy a hauler and a drill rig (unlicensed) for the fleet.

Operations panel: real logistics rows plus the new single 'Unclaimed Work' line (count from state.pendingActions, not one row repeated per eligible employee — that per-employee repeat is exactly what #39 removed).
